paper.usage: Fine cardstock fibre for cut pieces. Grey DETAIL map, linear data, mean 0.5: albedo.rgb *= 2.0 * d (== 1 + (2d-1)*strength). With a stock MeshStandardMaterial: map=this (NoColorSpace) and material.color multiplied by 2. NOT an sRGB albedo.

paperNormal.usage: Tangent-space normal for `paper` (same repeat/UV). OpenGL +Y convention for flipY=true. normalScale 1.0 = 5.5 deg mean tilt; 0.6-1.5 is sensible.

paperRough.usage: Roughness in all channels (three reads G). Mean 0.93, min >= 0.80: dead matte. Shared by card and page stock. metalness = 0.

pagePaper.usage: Rougher book-page stock (longer visible fibres). Same DETAIL convention as `paper`: albedo.rgb *= 2.0 * d. For a page wider than ~3 tiles blend a second sample at repeat2 (0.5/0.5, rotate 90 deg) to hide the period.

pagePaperNormal.usage: Tangent-space normal for `pagePaper`. OpenGL +Y, flipY=true. normalScale 1.0 = 6 deg mean tilt.

pagePaperRough.usage: Same file as paperRough (reuse the texture object; only the repeat differs).

edgeStrip.usage: Luminance for edge faces; multiply by the core colour #FBF6EA (or the book-board colour). U runs ALONG the edge (repeat = world units per U tile), V across the thickness. Two bands, V given for flipY=true: pageBlock = stacked sheets of the book block (30 sheet lines, irregular gaps); cutEdge = one card sheet (bright fuzzy core, darker compressed rims).

printAtlas.usage: All printed-detail overlays in one RGBA texture for the single shared cardstock material. Each cell: 448 px tileable content + 32 px wrapped gutter (keep UVs inside the cell rect; worldSize = suggested world units across the rect). A = ink coverage (straight alpha), RGB = ink composited over white. dark ink: albedo *= mix(vec3(1), rgb, k); or mix(albedo, yourInk, a*k). light ink (ripple): albedo = mix(albedo, #FBF6EA, a*k). Fibre detail multiplies AFTER the print so ink never hides fibre.

table.usage: Dark warm walnut table beyond the book, mean ~ #2D1C14 (surround umber). Real sRGB albedo, grain along U. Meant to sit out of focus; roughness 0.7-0.8, no normal map needed.

blueNoise.usage: 128 px tiling blue noise, 3 independent uniform channels (0..1). For post: grain, dither, DOF sample rotation. Sample with gl_FragCoord.xy / 128 (+ per-frame offset from state.time).

art.usage: Illustrated cut-paper sprite atlas. Sampled by the paper material with uv1 (glTF TEXCOORD_1, top-left origin => flipY false) on art-card faces; sprite rects and outlines in art/atlas.json.
